_README: PSX slow-macro manual overrides for the dashboard's Pakistan-economy tab. The scanner reads this file FIRST: a non-null value here WINS over the free TheGlobalEconomy/TradingEconomics fetch and over last-good. Update quarterly from the AKD / Topline Pakistan economy report (or SBP). Leave a field null to let the scanner's own fetch + last-good handle it. Only the macro keys below are read; _README / _sources are ignored. kse100 is also supported (optional) if you ever need to pin the official close.

_sources.reer: Real Effective Exchange Rate index — SBP REER/NEER monthly statistical release, or the AKD/Topline economy report. This is the one field currently blank (no reliable free feed); enter it here to light up the panel.
_sources.pak_ca: Current-account balance, USD million, latest month — SBP / AKD-Topline economy report.
_sources.pak_fiscal: Fiscal balance as % of GDP — AKD/Topline / Ministry of Finance.
_sources.pak_cpi: CPI YoY % — normally auto-fetched (TheGlobalEconomy); set only to correct it.
_sources.sbp_reserves: SBP FX reserves, USD billion — normally auto-fetched/last-good; set only to correct it.
